source: Agent-authored fictional knowledge needs for the Spanish technical example. These are not requirements endorsed by a MAYA site or attributed to actual workshops.

requirements.text: Remember which language each survivor wants to use for conversations and educational information, independently of the site's usual language.
Record whether a person wants short explanations or more detailed information when receiving support.
Keep the registration linking a participant to the study site, study phase, assigned arm and participation period.
Specify a consistent procedure for obtaining systolic and diastolic blood pressure readings at home.
Identify the instrument made up of questions that a participant answers to obtain an assessment score.
Represent the particular support a survivor needs to access or understand health information.
Describe features such as captions or an audio alternative that make educational content accessible.
Keep a record of the exercise session that actually took place, distinct from the session scheduled in advance.
Represent the prescribed exercise activities, duration and intensity that a participant is asked to follow.
Maintain an organised history of the oncology treatments received by a survivor.
Keep the participant's consent decision, its current status and the period during which that record applies.
Identify the publication or study that provides evidence supporting health information.
Represent an instruction to change intake of a particular food component, including its target amount and unit.
Describe the site's regional language setting, country and time zone.
Distinguish publications that validate an assessment instrument from publications that merely provide background information about it.
